defaultMode.label: Where stock and orders come from
defaultMode.help: Our ERP, another ERP, or no ERP. A store that has its own choice on the stock page keeps it. With an ERP but no keys yet, the shop practises against a pretend ERP and its stock stays as it is.

requestTimeoutSeconds.label: Wait for the ERP (seconds)
requestTimeoutSeconds.help: How long one call to the ERP may take before it counts as failed.

maxAttempts.label: Tries per ERP call
maxAttempts.help: When the ERP is busy or does not answer, try again up to this many times in total. A wrong key is never tried again.

backoffBaseMs.label: First pause before trying again (milliseconds)
backoffBaseMs.help: Each further pause is twice as long, up to the longest pause below.

backoffMaxMs.label: Longest pause before trying again (milliseconds)
backoffMaxMs.help: Also the most the shop waits when the ERP asks it to come back later.

backoffJitter.label: Spread the pauses a little
backoffJitter.help: Waits a random part of each pause, so many tries do not all hit the ERP at the same moment.

pageSize.label: Rows per page from the ERP
pageSize.help: How many stock rows the shop asks for in one call.

maxPagesPerRun.label: Most pages in one stock pull
maxPagesPerRun.help: A safety stop. The next pull carries on where this one stopped.

stockPollMinutes.label: Check the ERP's stock every (minutes)
stockPollMinutes.help: The shop asks for stock that changed since the last check, so a missed message from the ERP never leaves stock wrong.

updatedSinceOverlapSeconds.label: Read back a little further (seconds)
updatedSinceOverlapSeconds.help: Each check also reads this much before the last one, in case the two clocks differ. Rows read twice change nothing.

maxAgeSeconds.label: Oldest message accepted from the ERP (seconds)
maxAgeSeconds.help: A signed message older than this is refused, so an old one cannot be sent again.

enabled.label: Take stock news from the ERP right away
enabled.help: On: the ERP tells the shop about every stock or product change at once (signed messages). Off: the shop only asks the ERP every few minutes.

dedupeHours.label: Same ERP message within (hours)
dedupeHours.help: A message the ERP sends again within this time is recognised and used once.

maxBodyKb.label: Largest ERP message (KB)
maxBodyKb.help: A bigger message is refused before it is read.

batchSize.label: ERP messages handled per round
batchSize.help: How many waiting ERP messages the background worker takes at a time.

stockEnabled.label: Use the pretend ERP's stock
stockEnabled.help: Only for tests and demos. Off: while there are no ERP keys, the shop's stock is never touched.

timeoutSeconds.label: Live stock check at checkout (seconds)
timeoutSeconds.help: The last check before an order asks the ERP once and waits this long. No answer: the shop uses its own copy of the stock, so checkout never waits.

maxAttempts.label: Tries for each document sent to the ERP
maxAttempts.help: An order or other document that the ERP does not take is tried again up to this many times, with longer pauses; then it waits for someone to look at it.

backoffBaseSeconds.label: First pause before sending again (seconds)
backoffBaseSeconds.help: Each further pause is twice as long, up to the longest pause below.

backoffMaxSeconds.label: Longest pause before sending again (seconds)
backoffMaxSeconds.help: The pause between tries never grows past this.

batchSize.label: Documents sent to the ERP in one round
batchSize.help: At most this many documents are sent in one round; the rest follow in the next.

relaySeconds.label: Send waiting documents every (seconds)
relaySeconds.help: How often the shop sends orders and other documents that are waiting for the ERP.

defaults.label: Locations every new warehouse gets
defaults.help: Code, kind and name of each. The damaged bin is one of them.

requireDamagedBin.label: Every warehouse keeps a damaged bin
requireDamagedBin.help: The last damaged bin of a warehouse cannot be archived. Damaged stock is never sold.

sellableLocationKinds.label: Sell from these kinds of location
sellableLocationKinds.help: Stock in these locations counts as available on the shop. The damaged bin never counts.

stockLocationCode.label: Location that receives the ERP's stock
stockLocationCode.help: In each warehouse linked to an ERP warehouse, the ERP's stock numbers go into the location with this code.

holdMinutes.label: Checkout hold for a guest (minutes)
holdMinutes.help: When a guest starts checkout, the pieces in the bag are held for everyone else on all stores for this long. Each step of checkout starts the time again.

holdMinutesSignedIn.label: Checkout hold for a signed-in customer (minutes)
holdMinutesSignedIn.help: The same hold for a customer who is signed in.

abandonMinutes.label: Let go of an idle bag after (minutes)
abandonMinutes.help: When nothing happens in a bag for this long, its held pieces go back on sale, even before the hold time is over.

convertedHoldHours.label: An order's hold lasts at most (hours)
convertedHoldHours.help: After an order is placed its pieces stay held until the ERP's stock shows the order. If the ERP never shows it, the hold ends after this many hours.

maxUnitsPerLine.label: Most pieces of one variant held for one bag
maxUnitsPerLine.help: A bag cannot hold more pieces than this of one colour and size.

lockRetries.label: Tries again when two checkouts meet
lockRetries.help: When two checkouts reach for the same piece at the same moment, the second one waits and tries again up to this many times.

sweepSeconds.label: Check for ended holds every (seconds)
sweepSeconds.help: How often the shop looks for holds whose time is over and puts those pieces back on sale.

batchSize.label: Holds handled in one round
batchSize.help: At most this many ended holds are put back in one round; the rest follow in the next.

enabled.label: Low-stock alerts
enabled.help: Note when a colour and size is almost out, once for all stores together. The message itself is sent by the notification settings.

defaultThreshold.label: Almost out at this many pieces or fewer
defaultThreshold.help: A colour and size with this many sellable pieces or fewer gets a low-stock alert. 0 means only when it is sold out.

skuThresholds.label: Own limit for single variants (by SKU)
skuThresholds.help: A different "almost out" number for some SKUs, e.g. a fast seller. SKUs not listed use the number above.

sweepMinutes.label: Check every variant for low stock every (minutes)
sweepMinutes.help: Besides after every stock update, the shop checks all variants this often.

reasons.label: Reasons for a counting difference
reasons.help: When a counted number differs from the ERP's, one of these reasons is chosen. Each has a short key and its text in English and Bengali.

requireReason.label: A difference needs a reason
requireReason.help: A stock count can only be finished when every line that differs has a reason.

maxLines.label: Most lines in one stock count
maxLines.help: A stock count of one location holds at most this many colour-and-size lines.

maxQuantityPerScan.label: Most pieces in one scan
maxQuantityPerScan.help: One scan can add at most this many pieces (a box scanned with its count).

recheckAfterPull.label: Recheck products when their ERP stock changes
recheckAfterPull.help: When the ERP's stock for a product changes, its publish checklist runs again, so the "ready to publish" queue follows the real stock.

discoverMaxPages.label: Pages read when looking for new ERP styles
discoverMaxPages.help: Looking for ERP styles the shop does not have yet reads at most this many pages from the ERP.

maxRows.label: Most rows in the stock movement report
maxRows.help: The movement report and the check against the ERP show at most this many rows; narrow the dates or the SKU for more.

defaultDays.label: Days the movement report opens on
defaultDays.help: The stock movement report first shows this many days up to today; any other dates can be chosen on the page.

everyHours.label: Check all stock against the ERP every (hours)
everyHours.help: The shop compares every stock number with the ERP this often and lists what does not match. Nothing is changed by the check.

recentRuns.label: Recent sync runs shown
recentRuns.help: How many of the latest sync runs the stock page lists.

listSize.label: Rows per list on the stock page
listSize.help: How many low-stock items and waiting documents the stock page shows at a time.

lateAfterMinutes.label: Stock counts as late after (minutes)
lateAfterMinutes.help: The stock page warns when the last good stock pull from the ERP is older than this.
